scripts.validate:ci: pnpm --filter @surfaces/interfacectl-validator run build && pnpm --filter @surfaces/interfacectl-cli run build && node scripts/print-provenance.mjs && pnpm exec interfacectl validate --workspace-root . --contract ./contracts/surfaces.web.contract.json
scripts.cli:where:local: node -e "const pkg = require('./interfacectl-tooling/packages/interfacectl-cli/package.json'); const {execSync} = require('child_process'); console.log('=== Local Workspace CLI ==='); try { const bin = execSync('pnpm exec which interfacectl', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('Binary:', bin); } catch { console.log('Binary: node_modules/.bin/interfacectl'); } try { const version = execSync('pnpm exec interfacectl --version', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('Version:', version); } catch { console.log('Version:', pkg.version); } try { const sha = execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('Git SHA:', sha); } catch { console.log('Git SHA: not a git repo'); }"
scripts.cli:where:ci: node -e "const pkg = require('./interfacectl-tooling/packages/interfacectl-cli/package.json'); const {execSync} = require('child_process'); console.log('=== CI/Prod Workspace CLI ==='); console.log('Build status: CLI packages built from source'); try { const bin = execSync('pnpm exec which interfacectl', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('Binary:', bin); } catch { console.log('Binary: node_modules/.bin/interfacectl'); } try { const version = execSync('pnpm exec interfacectl --version', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('Version:', version); } catch { console.log('Version:', pkg.version); } try { const sha = execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim(); console.log('Git SHA:', sha); } catch { console.log('Git SHA: not a git repo'); }"
scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter surfaces-web dev & pnpm --filter surfaceops-web dev & pnpm --filter interfacectl-web dev & pnpm --filter surfaces-dev dev
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter @surfaces/ui type-check && pnpm --filter surfaces-web type-check && pnpm --filter surfaceops-web type-check && pnpm --filter interfacectl-web type-check && pnpm --filter surfaces-dev type-check
